title: Chapter 126 Unknown Star Field, Unknown Enemy
content:
Chapter 126 Unknown Star Field, Unknown Enemy

Boom!

Accompanied by a deafening buzzing sound.

The border barrier that had protected the Tianlin Star Region for endless years shattered.

"God's will, God's will is so!!"

Han Tianren, the old master of the Tianlin Palace, looked at the army of the Divine Dynasty that had entered the Tianlin Star Region in front of him with great grief. He could no longer suppress his inner grief and anger, and roared to the sky.

"Damn it, fight them!"

"Fight!!"

Several forces in the Tianlin Star Region, led by the Tianlin Palace, rushed towards the Divine Dynasty strongmen.

They started to fight like they didn't care about their lives!

Seeing this scene, Wang Zhen sneered. In his eyes, these were just impotent rage.

In his eyes, there was no sympathy.

Because this was not a game of house, but an extremely cruel war era.

Weak strength is destined to be invaded.

To be honest, don't think these star regions are so united now, that's because their Divine Dynasty is so powerful, they have no choice but to unite to fight against their Divine Dynasty.

If their Divine Dynasty is weak, let's not talk about whether it will be destroyed.

It is estimated that these forces have already fought over resource and territory issues.

Unfortunately, the reality is that it is their Divine Dynasty that is powerful.

Their Zhishen Star Region has a peerless empress who created the strongest force in all known star regions, the Divine Dynasty!

"Ah! Your Divine Dynasty will not die well!!"

"No, don't kill me, I surrender!"

"Save me!"

Even though the Tianlin Star Region has tried its best, it is still because of the huge disparity in strength that some died and some escaped.

As for those strong men from the Huoling Star Region and the Hun Gu Star Region who came to help, they had already run away when the border barrier was broken.

This is reality.

I don't know how long it took.

The battlefield finally returned to calm.

In the starry sky, the old sword cultivator was covered in blood, his breath was weak, the three-foot divine sword had long been broken, and there was nothing on both sides of his shoulders.

At this time, he seemed to have lost his ability to fight.

But at this moment, there was no fear in the old sword cultivator's eyes, but his expression became more fierce.

Looking at the old sword cultivator, Ao Qing looked casual.

"How to deal with this guy?"

Hearing this, Wang Zhen pondered for a moment, and then said: "Take him back."

Ao Qing nodded.

Before coming, Yan Lingyun had already told him that when he saw a strong man with good strength, he should not kill him, just let Wang Zhen deal with it.

But Ao Qing didn't understand.

Why keep him alive if he didn't kill him?

Ao Qing shook his head, and then circled his huge body towards the depths of Tianlin Star Region.

Next, it was his favorite part.

Searching for spoils.

.........

On the other side, inside the Divine Dynasty.

The message was transmitted very quickly.

In the Divine Dynasty Hall, Yan Lingyun already knew the news that Tianlin Star Region had been captured.

At this time, a figure entered the hall and said slowly: "Your Majesty, the Fire Spirit Star Region sent someone to say that they want to form an alliance with our Divine Dynasty."

Hearing this, the whole hall was slightly stunned, and then sneered.

Alliance?

What kind of cattle and horse forces are worthy of forming an alliance with our Divine Dynasty.

On the dragon throne, Yan Lingyun's face was like black ice, and he slowly said: "Tell them that our Divine Dynasty will not form an alliance with any force. Either surrender or die."

Hearing this, the figure nodded without any nonsense, and then disappeared in the hall.

At this time, an old man stepped forward and said: "Your Majesty, I have something to report."

"Speak."

"Your Majesty, I recently discovered a very powerful force, and it is very powerful. It has been expanding outward, and its direction seems to be heading towards our Divine Dynasty."

Hearing this, everyone in the hall suddenly looked at each other.

There is such a bold and reckless force.

The next moment, a middle-aged man with a strong aura stepped forward and said: "Your Majesty, I am willing to lead the troops and eliminate the other party!"

This statement is extremely confident.

Because he is the only divine general still in the Divine Dynasty.

His strength is slightly weaker than Wang Zhen.

Suddenly, everyone looked at Yan Lingyun, waiting for His Majesty's reply.

Such an arrogant and domineering force simply does not take their Divine Dynasty seriously.

At the same time, this is also a threat. They believe that His Majesty will never allow such a force to exist.

However, what they did not expect was that Yan Lingyun did not agree, but slowly asked: "What is the name of that force?"

Hearing this, the old man respectfully said: "Your Majesty, that force is called Huangcheng, which is extremely far away from here, but the other party's expansion direction is constantly coming here. Your Majesty, this old minister dares to guess that the other party's goal is very likely to be our Divine Dynasty!"

As soon as this was said, all the ministers frowned.

Target Divine Dynasty?

What a courage.

What era is this? Is there anyone who has not heard of the horror of their Divine Dynasty?

At this moment, they did not notice Yan Lingyun's expression at all, and they were all a little indignant.

On the dragon throne, Yan Lingyun's mouth corners suddenly rose slightly, as if she thought of something.

"Cough."

At this time, Yan Lingyun coughed lightly.

The hall suddenly became quiet.

Yan Lingyun said, "Don't pay attention to it. The deserted city is not our enemy."

Hearing this, the people below were slightly stunned.

From the tone of your majesty, it seems that you know the deserted city.

That's right!

They suddenly thought that His Majesty seemed to have left for a while not long ago, and when he came back, he brought back the princess inexplicably.

Could it be that the princess was from there?

The minds of several people turned very quickly, and they soon guessed it.

After leaving the hall, Yan Lingyun came to the high platform of the Palace of the Divine Dynasty and looked somewhere.

"It will come sooner or later."

Yan Lingyun slowly smiled.

"But this time, I am not fighting alone."

.........

Somewhere in the hazy star field.

Going deeper here, it is an area collectively referred to as the unknown star field by the world.

The unknown star field, as the name suggests, is a place that has never been set foot on, and there is no record or understanding of it.

And no living creature has ever come out of it.

And at this moment, a strange voice suddenly sounded from the star field.

The next moment, the energy in the surrounding space suddenly disappeared.

The starry sky gradually dimmed.

If there were any strong men here at this moment, they would be horrified.

Unknown star field, unknown enemy!

"Damn woman, this time, I want to see what you can do to stop our people!"

A ferocious voice sounded from the depths.

Boom!

The void was broken, and countless strange auras rushed out.

In just a moment, the entire area suddenly turned into nothingness.

.........

Fire Spirit Star Field.

In a palace burning with divine flames.

"Master, why don't we run away? As long as we have the green mountains, we will not be afraid of running out of firewood."

Hearing this, the Emperor Yan Yan was immediately furious.

"Run, can you run forever?!"

The Emperor Yan Yan roared.

Immediately, the man lowered his head and dared not say a word.

The hall fell into silence again.

At this moment, they were a little desperate.

Even a super-god-level sword cultivator suddenly appeared in Tianlin Star Region, but he was defeated.

What about Huoling Star Region?

After the Divine Dynasty has dealt with Tianlin Star Region, they will be the next one.

It is worth mentioning that every time the Divine Dynasty invades a star region, it only deals with the top forces, and basically does not interfere too much with the lower ones.

So only the top forces in their star regions are really willing to fight to the death.

Only those strong people with strong feelings will be willing to come to help.

After all, after being invaded by the Divine Dynasty, the name of that star region will no longer exist.

Otherwise, why do you think the territory of the Divine Dynasty is so huge?

Now, who will remember those star regions invaded by the Divine Dynasty?
